2,3-dihydro-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-5,6,7,8-tetramethoxy-4H-1-benzopyran-4-one is a methoxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 5, 6, 7 and 8 and a hydroxy group at position 4'. Dulxanthone D is a member of xanthones.

(2S)-2'-methoxykurarinone is a dimethoxyflavanone that is (2S)-()-kurarinone in which the hydroxy group at position 2' is replaced by a methoxy group. Isolated from the roots of Sophora flavescens, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human myeloid leukemia HL-60 cells. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones, a dimethoxyflavanone and a dihydroxyflavanone. It is functionally related to a (2S)-(-)-kurarinone.

Demethoxycurcumin is a beta-diketone that is curcumin in which one of the methoxy groups is replaced by hydrogen. It is found in Curcuma zedoaria and Etlingera elatior. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a polyphenol, an enone, a beta-diketone and a diarylheptanoid.
